description.value: Dami Sushi & Korean Restaurant is a neighbourhood dine-in and takeout spot in East Vancouver serving a dual menu of Japanese sushi and Korean cuisine. The restaurant emphasizes fresh ingredients and friendly service, positioning itself as a one-stop destination for cravings spanning both culinary traditions. Online ordering is available directly through their website.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 4m; stands (2 spaces) at 34m; stands (2 spaces) at 47m; stands (2 spaces) at 50m; stands (15 spaces, covered) at 61m; rack (7 spaces) at 68m; stands (4 spaces) at 91m. Total: 35 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is real, open, and operating at the OSM address with matching phone number. The site features an 'Order Now' button powered by ePOSbridge, confirming takeout/online ordering is available. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike rack, Wi-Fi, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null. A minor discrepancy exists between OSM hours (Tu-Su 11:00-22:00) and website hours (Monday-Sunday 11:30am-11pm); flagged in concerns.
concerns: Hours discrepancy: OSM lists Tu-Su 11:00-22:00 (closed Mondays, closes 10pm), but website states Monday-Sunday 11:30am-11pm (open 7 days, closes 11pm). Website value is likely more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by live website. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists in East Vancouver.

wow_evidence: neighbourhood dine-in and takeout spot in East Vancouver
